verdict_dual.host_side: The lambda-cubed Edgeworth shell genuinely improves the Q24 host: protected-40 raw host MSE 8.030968799749751e-8 versus the base host's 8.919980524938374e-8, a 9.967% reduction - the first real host-accuracy improvement of the campaign, with the mathematics machine-certified and every rollout finite at about 2.0e12 FLOPs.
verdict_dual.system_side: The refit-J corrected pilot is 3.136551362360925e-8 versus the J-native baseline 3.107235383605394e-8, a 0.943% regression; the scaling gate fails and the arm closes. J corrected 65.17% of the base host's error but only 60.94% of the X host's smaller residual: the shell removes precisely the systematic fourth-order component the observer could already reconstruct.
verdict_dual.synthesis: The corrected system sits at an invariant near 3.1e-8 in the native pilot frame (3.23e-8 development frame) that is now measured from BOTH directions: five observer arms on the fixed host and three host arms under the frozen observer form all land there. This is the joint information floor of the current architecture; raw 1e-8 requires a structurally different system, not another lever inside this one.

board_note: An X-based card would be worse than the banked W2 conditional-repair card on both raw and adjusted; W2 remains the best available candidate.
